title: Laser directed energy deposited Al0.8Nb0.5Ti2V2Zr0.5 lightweight refractory high entropy alloy: Regionalization of microstructure characteristics and strengthening mechanisms
process_description: prepared by laser directed energy deposition (LDED) using pre-alloyed powder under an argon atmosphere with oxygen content below 100 ppm. The process parameters employed were a laser power of 1200 W, a layer thickness of 600 μm, a scanning speed of 10 mm/s and a scanning spacing of 1500 μm.
